transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm here because things are kind of out of hand. Um... after I eat too much, I've been... going to the bathroom and making myself throw up. I just don't want to put on weight. But... it's happening a lot. I'm kind of scared I can't stop doing it now.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?

Well... it's been going on for a while. Um, for at least the past three months, I guess. There's hardly been a week where I didn't... you know, eat too much late at night and then... have to go get rid of it. Sometimes it's a few times a week. Especially lately, since I've been stuck at home more with a bad back. It just... happens.
When you say you 'eat too much', do you feel like you're eating an amount of food that's definitely larger than what most people would eat under similar circumstances?

Yeah, I guess so. I mean... at night, when everything's quiet, I'll just stand in the kitchen. I'll eat whatever's there. Leftovers, cereal, chips... ice cream. I just keep going. Way past what a normal meal would be. By the time I stop, half the pantry looks picked over. So... yeah, it's a lot.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yeah. I mean... if the scale goes up even a pound, I... I kind of panic. Being laid up with my back, I just feel like I'm turning soft. So... I just start figuring out how to undo it. Before I can even really think straight.
Do you think your weight or body shape is different from what it really is?

I don't know about different... I just know what I see. When I put on my work pants and they feel even a little tight, or... or I see my stomach in the mirror, it's just... I don't know. It feels like I'm failing. Like I'm losing who I am. I used to be strong, you know? I could pull transmissions, keep up with the guys at the shop... and now I just see this person who can't even fit in her clothes right. It just... it takes over how I feel about myself.
Do you think you would still be afraid of gaining weight if you knew for certain that your weight and body shape were perfectly healthy?
I don't know... I mean, I guess it's hard to imagine not worrying about it. It just... it doesn't really matter what healthy is supposed to look like, I just know I don't want to get bigger.
Do you think there's a specific weight or body shape that you're trying to maintain or achieve?

Not an exact number, no. It's just... like I said before. If my work pants feel tight, or I catch my belly in the mirror, I just... I feel like I'm failing at everything. I just want to be that strong woman who used to handle transmissions and keep up with the guys. I don't want to lose that.
Have you ever eaten a large amount of food in a short period of time without making yourself throw up afterwards?

I... no. Not really. If I eat like that, I... I always get rid of it. It's been like that for a while now. For the last three months or so, there hasn't really been a week where I didn't do it at least once. Sometimes more, especially when my back is acting up and I'm stuck at home. But I always... I always make sure to throw it up.
Do you think you would still want to throw up after eating if you didn't care about your weight or body shape?
I don't really know. I guess... I haven't really thought about it like that. It's just what I do.
Do you feel like you're in control when you're eating these large amounts of food?

Not really. I... once I start on those nights, it's like my hands just keep grabbing food. Even while I'm telling myself, you know, Lucy, knock it off... I just... I don't feel back in charge until it's already done.
Have you ever eaten a large amount of food in a short period of time without trying to get rid of it afterwards?
I... didn't you just ask me that? No. Like I said, I always try to get rid of it. I don't just... let it sit there.
Do you think you would see yourself as fat even if someone you trust told you that you are not?

I mean... yeah. Probably. It doesn't really matter what anyone else tells me. 

If my work pants feel tight... or if I just catch my belly in the mirror... that's what I see. It just... it makes me feel like I'm failing at everything. Like I'm not... I don't know. Like I'm not the strong woman who used to handle heavy transmissions and keep up with the guys at the shop anymore. So... yeah. I'd still see it.
Have you ever had an episode where you ate a large amount of food in a short period of time without trying to get rid of it afterwards, but still felt like you had lost control while eating?
I... look, I thought I just answered that. No. If I lose control and eat like that, I always... I always do something to get rid of it. I don't ever just let it stay there.
Do you think your body shape or weight is the main thing that determines your self-worth?

I... I don't know if it's the main thing. But... yeah. Like I was just saying... if my pants are tight or... or I see my stomach, it's just... it's all I can think about. It feels like I'm failing. Like I'm losing that part of me that used to be strong enough to pull a transmission. So... yeah, I guess it matters a lot.
Do you think you would still see yourself as overweight even if you were at a healthy weight according to a doctor?
I... yeah. Probably. I mean, I don't know what a doctor's chart says. It's just... what I see.
Do you usually make yourself throw up after eating because you're afraid of gaining weight from the calories you consumed?

Yeah... I do. That's... that's why I'm here, I guess. After I eat like that, I just... I go to the bathroom and I make myself sick. I just can't handle the thought of those calories staying in me and making me gain weight. And... I don't know, it's just gotten to the point where I'm scared I can't stop doing it.
Do you make yourself throw up after eating because you feel like you've lost control while eating, or is it only because you're afraid of gaining weight?

I guess... both. It's the weight, but... it's also how it happens. Once I start on those nights, it's like... my hands just keep grabbing food. Even when I'm in my head saying, "Lucy, knock it off." I just... I can't stop it. I don't feel like I'm back in charge until... until it's already done. So, I make myself sick to try and fix it.
Is making yourself throw up after eating more about undoing the calories or about feeling like you've regained control over your eating?
I don't really know. I guess... it's just what I do. I haven't really thought about which one it is. It's just... both, I guess.
Is making yourself throw up after eating mostly to prevent weight gain or to make yourself feel better after losing control while eating?
I... I don't know. It's just what happens. I haven't really... picked it apart like that.
Is making yourself throw up after eating mostly to undo the calories you consumed?
Yeah... I guess so. So I don't put on weight. After I eat too much, I just... go to the bathroom and make myself sick. It's just... I'm getting kind of scared that I can't stop doing it now.
